name: n8n Trigger
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: The n8n Trigger node triggers when the workflow containing this node updates or gets published, or when the n8n instance starts or restarts. This node only responds to events in its own workflow; changes to other workflows won't trigger it

parameters.name: Published Workflow Updated
parameters.description: If you select this event, the node triggers when the workflow containing this node is updated. Changes to other workflows won't trigger this node

parameters.name: Instance started
parameters.description: If you select this event, the node triggers when the n8n instance starts or restarts

parameters.name: Workflow Published
parameters.description: If you select this event, the node triggers when the workflow containing this node is published. Publishing other workflows won't trigger this node

parameters.name: events

options.name: Published Workflow Updated
options.description: Triggers when workflow version is published from a published state (workflow was already published)

options.name: Instance Started
options.description: Triggers when this n8n instance is started or re-started

options.name: Workflow Published
options.description: Triggers when workflow version is published from an unpublished state (workflow was not published)

parameters.description:
Specifies under which conditions an execution should happen:
  • Published Workflow Updated: Triggers when workflow version is published from a published state (workflow was already published)
